scope: Ordinary driving cap handback and explicit FSM pending outcome; not whole HBQ parity
sourceIntent: HBQ deliberate route waits must not become stuck recovery. Its route-refresh branch force-releases speed and reenables movement; CBE instead preserves exact authored route and original cap authority.
reviewLimit: routeWaiting read; refreshRoute selected header/commanded-vehicle/fixed-path cleanup sections. No whole driveAssist branch coverage claimed. Protected sources unchanged.
implementation: Unconfirmed original baseline restoration retains state/restore proof and first seven-field cap work receipt.
Cap-only retry binds original state/restore/group/epoch/deadline/driver/commander, current group membership/locality, no newer child controller and exact native applied cap.
Retries skip pass, reverse, corridor, bypass and native-path cleanup; ordinary Start takes this path before any per-vehicle child work and cannot capture the pending cap as a new baseline.
CAP tickets reuse existing four-ticket observer and original30second server deadline. Expiry/handover refusal retains unresolved proof; successor state survives.
Driving FSM reports CAP_RELEASE_PENDING/UNRESOLVED through existing queue. CapRelease priority6 remains below Delay8, so pending status does not bypass cadence.
limits: No physical restoration-failure reproduction, driving/convoy gap acceptance or measured performance.
Ordinary receipts are owner-local. This does not implement cross-HC adoption or actual external-provider quiescence.
Changed seats/epoch/child ownership may end retries unresolved. New mission route is not replayed; cap-only restore removes only the still-owned setting.
Retained proof does not guarantee eventual handback after the finite window or controller shutdown.

followupExternalRefusal.finding: Cap-only retry skipped restoration under current external authority but then retired unchanged pending cap and original baseline. Refusal was incorrectly treated as handback.
followupExternalRefusal.resolution: Exact pending cap under current external/convoy/movement-owner authority exits final transaction UNRESOLVED_HANDOVER before native write or receipt deletion. Changed native cap follows existing retirement. No quiescence acknowledgement or deadline renewal.
followupExternalRefusal.limits: Source/offline evidence only. Cross-owner pending-cap adoption remains unimplemented; no physical provider takeover or restoration evidence. Audits paused.
